title: Understanding and Stabilizing Deep Q-Learning via Controlled Bootstrapping and Regulated Value Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2608.16182v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Deep Q-learning (DQL) has achieved remarkable empirical success in reinforcement learning, yet its training process remains notoriously unstable. Existing studies often attribute instability to isolated factors such as overestimation bias or representation learning issues, lacking a unified understanding of how different sources of instability interact during recursive value estimation. In this work, we provide a systematic analysis of instability in deep Q-learning from three complementary perspectives: operator-level bias in Bellman bootstrapping, estimator-level sensitivity of greedy action selection to regression noise, and parameter-dynamics imbalance under aggressive data reuse. We identify a reward-triggered self-reinforcing trap and characteristic parameter spike dynamics, then derive stabilization principles for controlled bootstrapping, ensemble quantile estimation, and spike-based parameter regulation. Experiments on Atari-1

translated_title: 理解并稳定深度Q学习：通过受控自举与调节价值动态
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.16182v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：深度Q学习（DQL）在强化学习中取得了显著的实证成功，但其训练过程仍以不稳定著称。现有研究常将不稳定性归因于孤立因素，如过估计偏差或表示学习问题，缺乏对不同不稳定源在递归价值估计过程中如何相互作用的统一理解。在本工作中，我们从三个互补视角对深度Q学习中的不稳定性进行了系统分析：贝尔曼自举中的算子级偏差、贪心动作选择对回归噪声的估计器级敏感性，以及激进数据重用下的参数动态失衡。我们识别出奖励触发的自我强化陷阱和特征性参数尖峰动态，进而推导出受控自举、集成分位数估计和基于尖峰的参数调节的稳定化原则。在Atari-1上的实验验证了这些原则的有效性。
tldr: 本文系统剖析了深度Q学习不稳定的三大来源，提出受控自举、集成分位数估计和尖峰调节等稳定化原则，并在Atari-1上验证其有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically analyzes three sources of instability in deep Q-learning and proposes stabilization principles including controlled bootstrapping, ensemble quantile estimation, and spike-based regulation, validated on Atari-1.
